_comment: Fictional SaaS company, customers and engineers. All text is plain ASCII on purpose. Every record is pinned word for word with `fact add`, then labelled with `fact update --metadata` (tool, kind, who, when).

project.name: Tallyfold bug triage memory
project.description: Bug triage memory for Tallyfold (fictional invoicing SaaS): Linear investigations, GitHub PRs, the deploy log, Sentry alerts and helpdesk tickets in one project. Fictional data for the MemoryLake bug-triage-memory demo.

records.text: INV-12 Password reset emails land in spam for Outlook recipients. Root cause: the DKIM record for mail.tallyfold.example went missing in the DNS move. Fix: ops change OPS-77 added the record. Status: fixed by OPS-77 on 2026-04-21.

INV-27 PDF invoices show a box instead of the currency sign for CHF and SEK. Root cause: the PDF renderer fell back to a font without those glyphs. Fix: PR #455 bundles a font that has them. Workaround: send the invoice as a link instead of a PDF. Status: fixed by PR #455, shipped in 3.16.2 on 2026-06-09.

INV-31 Duplicate invoices in the QuickLedger sync: each invoice appears twice in the customer's QuickLedger books. Root cause: webhook retries re-sent invoice.created without an idempotency key. Fix: PR #482. Workaround: Settings > Integrations > QuickLedger > Remove duplicates. Status: fixed by PR #482, shipped in 3.17.0 on 2026-07-08.

INV-35 QuickLedger sync sends tax as zero for invoices with a discount line. Root cause: the discount was applied after the tax mapping. Fix: PR #498 maps tax first. Status: fixed by PR #498, shipped in 3.17.2 on 2026-07-24.

INV-38 Stripe payout reconciliation is one day off for customers east of UTC. Root cause: payout dates were compared in UTC. Fix: PR #510 compares them in the account time zone. Status: fixed by PR #510, shipped in 3.18.0 on 2026-08-14.

INV-40 Client CSV import rejects files saved by Excel with a byte order mark. Root cause: the parser read the mark as part of the first column name. Fix: PR #520 strips it. Status: fixed by PR #520, shipped in 3.18.2 on 2026-09-02.

INV-44 Recurring invoices scheduled for the 31st are skipped in months with 30 days or fewer. Root cause: the scheduler looks for day 31 and finds none. Fix: PR #561 clamps the day to the length of the month. Workaround: schedule the invoice on 'last day of month'. Status: fixed by PR #561.
ENG-902 Re-land the delivery idempotency key with a cached lookup. State: backlog, unassigned, no milestone.
OPS-77 Add the DKIM record for mail.tallyfold.example. State: done 2026-04-21.
